Game Overview

In Vegas Crime Simulator, the core idea is straightforward: rule the neon-lit streets of Las Vegas, unleashing chaos as you engage in thrilling car chases, intense shootouts, and daring heists. Whether you're building your criminal empire or simply causing mayhem, Vegas Crime Simulator promises a dynamic sandbox experience that lets you decide how notorious you'll become.
